Retest Result: Mobile ticker renders with its copy; featured card identity/avatar present.
Notes: All items done and live. The ticker overlaps the card flush at 10px regular instead of floating above it; the avatar shows the reviewer's own photo (initial on a hue disc when they have none); identity reads @handle; the timestamp sits below the name instead of competing for the row; the headline splits into product (bold) and verdict (italic); the full canonical product name is used, so "Jisulife Handheld Fan Life9" is no longer shortened; and the stacked cards step down in rotation, opacity and shadow so the effect fades rather than ending on a hard edge. The badge now reads level AND number — "Verified Buyer · 63" — per the product decision to keep the level as the label. Worth knowing why both matter: all three real reviewers are "Verified Buyer", but they score 63, 63 and 17, so the level says what someone has unlocked and the number says how well they are actually doing. reputation_score (0..100, ADR-003) is now on the public author payload; formatting is in lib/trust.ts behind one TrustBadge component so the badge reads identically on the card, a review, both profiles and a Q&A answer. Screen readers get "Verified Buyer, trust score 63 out of 100". RETEST NOTE: the badge is fed by a 60-second Data Cache, so immediately after a deploy it can briefly show the level with no number before it refreshes — that is expected and self-healing.
